description.narrative: The proposed IFC investment is to support an SPV to be set up (the Project Company), jointly owned by EDF power solutions International S.A.S (50.99%), EDF power solutions Developpement S.A.S. (0.01%) and I-Environmental Investments Pacific Pty Ltd. (49%), for the development of greenfield hybrid plant including 90MWp/72MWac solar PV and 80 MWh BESS in Manatuto municipality, Timor-Leste (the Project). The Project is expected to be supported by IFC as implementing entity of IDA21 Private Sector Window (PSW) Blended Finance Facility (BFF) and IDA21 PSW Risk Mitigation Facility (RMF), and for its own account under IFCs Concessional Capital Window (CCW) for IDA21 (CCW-IDA21).

This Project is expected to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, provide energy at competitive tariffs and allow Timor-Leste to advance towards reaching its renewable energy targets. Beyond the project, this investment could improve the market competitiveness by demonstrating the viability of a solar PV plus battery storage market in Timor-Leste.
